scripts.generate: npm run link && golem generate --config apps/web/golem.yaml && golem generate --config apps/worker/golem.yaml
scripts.check: npm run generate && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run link && golem build --config apps/web/golem.yaml && golem build --config apps/worker/golem.yaml && node --test shared-folder.test.js "apps/*/.build/**/*.test.js"
